title: Junk Jack
mechanic: Hold vacuum to convert replenishing scrap into shot mass; release to blast destructible robots; optional explicit target and two-tap controls
upgrades: 6 stars: faster intake and visible coil nozzle
12 stars: eight-scrap chamber and visible side tanks
physics: deterministic constrained projectiles, damage and cosmetic detached-part motion; not general rigidbody physics

skills.game-design: one clear action/feedback/reward loop; first pickup in 0.06s; no danger before first input
skills.game-art: navy/yellow industrial palette, distinct human and robot silhouettes, actual rendered cover and SVG icon
skills.3d-games: connected tool-grip IK, batched environment and bounded part effects
skills.mobile-games: large primary button, held and two-tap alternatives, pause/input cancellation and Light mode
skills.web-games: local libraries/assets, no SDK startup dependency, capped DPR and frame presentation
skills.game-audio: gesture activation, layered synthesis, continuous-motor cleanup on interruption
